questions.q: In which year did the Martian Manhunter debut in Detective Comics #225?
questions.why: J'onn J'onzz first appeared in Detective Comics #225, dated November 1955.

questions.q: Which two creators introduced the Martian Manhunter?
questions.why: Joseph Samachson wrote and Joe Certa drew his 1955 debut.

questions.q: Which new ability did Detective Comics #226 add to J'onn's powers?
questions.why: Issue #226 gave him precognition, and telepathy and flight followed soon after.

questions.q: What human alias does J'onn J'onzz use on Earth?
questions.why: He blends in as the detective John Jones.

questions.q: How many heroes made up the original Silver Age JLA, with J'onn among them?
questions.why: J'onn was one of the seven founding members of the Justice League of America.

questions.q: What food obsession did J'onn develop during the 1987 JLA relaunch?
questions.why: A running gag from the 1987 relaunch is his love of 'Chocos', a cookie that stands in for Oreos.

questions.q: In his debut story, whose experimental device teleported J'onn from Mars to Earth?
questions.why: Scientist Saul Erdel's teleportation experiment accidentally pulled J'onn across space.

questions.q: Who voiced the Martian Manhunter in the DC Animated Universe's 2001-2006 JLA cartoon?
questions.why: Carl Lumbly gave J'onn his voice across the DC Animated Universe, using a South African accent.

questions.q: Which actor played J'onn J'onzz, disguised as Hank Henshaw, in the TV series Supergirl?
questions.why: David Harewood portrayed him in the Arrowverse's Supergirl.

questions.q: Which 2021 DC Extended Universe film finally shows J'onn J'onzz in his true form?
questions.why: Harry Lennix's General Swanwick turns out to be J'onn J'onzz in disguise, revealed in Zack Snyder's Justice League.
